Anant singh News : anant sinh ko phir vidhanasbha ki or se notis jari | Breaking News | Bihar Politics
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ko phir notis jari...
Vidhanasbha ki or se notis jari...
30 navanbar tak javab dene ka diya gaya samay...
Beti ki shadi ke karan anant sinh ne vidhan sabha se manga tha 45 dinon ka samay ...
Ab 30 tarikh tak anant sinh ko dena hoga javab...
Aapko bata den ki JDU ne part virodhi gatividhi ko lekar anant sinh ki sadasyata khatm karne ki anushansa karte hue vidhan sabha adhyaksh ko patr diya tha...jiske bad anant sinh ko javab talab kiya gaya hai...
